feeding_claim.verbatim: At Mahaffey Farms you can trust that our cattle has spent their entire life grazing on pasture.

resold_note: The farm store also sells milk, honey, cheeses, rice, beans and produce described as locally produced, without saying they come from this farm.
notes: Farm store and online shop at cultivate318.com under the Mahaffey Farms name. Checked the homepage, about us page, farm store page, pick up orders page, contact page and grass-fed beef store page. The beef page says grass fed and finished, cattle spend their entire life grazing on pasture, and no grain finishing, with a seasonal protein supplement noted. Pork and chicken are described as pasture raised, and the about page says Red Label means certified organic feed and Blue Label conventional feed. Farm store hours Monday to Friday 9 to 5 and Saturday 9 to 3; online orders for home delivery by zip code (Tuesday and Thursday) or pickup at the Haughton store or McCain Farms in Calhoun. The homepage says the business does not ship. A Buying In Bulk store category exists but I did not open it, so bulk_shares is false; the Verifier should check it. The site never says outright that every animal is raised on the farm, though the beef page and about page describe its own cattle and moving animals on pasture. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary, not raw text.
